title: 9 第9章 云水剑法10 第10章 激斗
content_zh:
罗毅不停的闪动，血眼狼的利爪被他逐一躲过。
只见罗毅移动的范围非常小，几乎都在一步之内，他就是通过这样小范围、高频率的移动，快速的躲过血眼狼的攻击。
“好精准的控制！”
林轩暗自惊叹，到现在为止，这罗毅还没有失误，他几乎是贴着血眼狼进攻的。
这种步法很高效，但是也很危险，一个失误，就可能受到重伤。
林轩想到这里，只听刺啦一声，罗毅的衣服被划出了一道口子，他的胸膛之上立刻出现了三道血痕。
“哼！
大浪滔天！”
罗毅冷哼一声，剑法突变，如同奔腾的大河，汹涌不止。
三尺长剑被海蓝色的灵力包裹，每挥出一剑，就如同一道海浪。
罗毅三剑连续挥出，蓝色灵力在空中激荡，那狂暴的力量席卷而去。
嗷呜！
血眼狼似乎感觉到危险，全身狼毛竖立，向一旁扑去。
嘭！
奈何血眼狼的速度还是慢了一步，被凌厉的长剑劈成两半，鲜血散落一地。
“罗毅哥的剑法真棒！”
队伍中有人欢呼。
“我觉得步法更棒。”
有人羡慕的问道，“毅哥，你刚才的步法太帅了！”
罗毅望着身后那些战组的成员，说道：“行了，把狼尸整理好，我们去完成下一个任务。”

林轩蹲在草丛中，脑海中还在回忆刚才的那种步法。
那不是什么特殊的武技，而是将一种步法练到的极高深的地步，再配合上精准的计算，才有了刚才的那一幕。
“好精妙，我喜欢！”
林轩十分心动，打算朝着这方面努力。
“先找阴行草。”
他并没有忘记出来的目的，整理好背包，他再次出发了。
终于，在一处山涧中，林轩发现了三株阴行草。
林轩大喜，当即从背包中拿出木盒，将其中一株阴行草摘下，放入木盒之中。
“咦，是阴行草！”
突然，身后有人惊呼。
林轩心中一沉，又摘了一株，放入木盒中，然后将木盒收起。
他留了一株在外面，两株对他来说足够了。
content_en:
Luo Yi kept flashing, dodging the sharp claws of the blood-eyed wolf one by one.
I saw that Luo Yi moved within a very small range, almost within one step. He quickly avoided the blood-eyed wolf's attack through such small-scale, high-frequency movements.
"What a precise control!"
Lin Xuan secretly marveled that so far, Luo Yi had not made any mistakes. He almost attacked close to the Blood-Eyed Wolf.
This footwork is very efficient, but it is also very dangerous. If you make a mistake, you may be seriously injured.
When Lin Xuan thought of this, he heard a stabbing sound, a cut was made in Luo Yi's clothes, and three blood marks immediately appeared on his chest.
"Hmph!
Big waves! "
Luo Yi snorted coldly, his swordsmanship suddenly changed, like a rushing river, surging incessantly.
The three-foot-long sword was wrapped in sea-blue spiritual power, and every time the sword was swung, it was like a wave of waves.
Luo Yi swung three swords in succession, blue spiritual power surged in the air, and the violent power swept away.
Ouch!
The blood-eyed wolf seemed to feel danger, its wolf fur stood on end, and it pounced to the side.
Bang!
However, the blood-eyed wolf was still a step slower and was split in half by the sharp sword, with blood scattered on the ground.
"Brother Luo Yi's swordsmanship is awesome!"
Someone in the team cheered.
"I think the footwork is better."
Someone asked enviously, "Brother Yi, your footwork just now was so cool!"
Luo Yi looked at the members of the battle group behind him and said, "Okay, put the wolf corpses in order, and let's complete the next mission."
Lin Xuan squatted in the grass, still recalling the footwork just now in his mind.
It was not a special martial skill, but a footwork practiced to an extremely advanced level, coupled with precise calculations, to achieve the scene just now.
"It's so exquisite, I like it!"
Lin Xuan is very excited and plans to work hard in this direction.
"Look for Yinxingcao first."
He did not forget the purpose of coming out. After packing his backpack, he set off again.
Finally, in a mountain stream, Lin Xuan discovered three Yin Xing grass.
Lin Xuan was overjoyed, and immediately took out the wooden box from his backpack, picked off one of the Yinxingcao plants, and put it into the wooden box.
"Hey, it's Yinxingcao!"
Suddenly, someone behind him exclaimed.
Lin Xuan's heart sank, he picked another one, put it in the wooden box, and then put the wooden box away.
He left one outside; two were enough for him.
